implementation_notes: The CSV manifest is the canonical detailed per-asset inventory.
Manrope and Inter are the authoritative typography system for current LuxSync web graphics.
The 97 SVG-based graphics are generated in-repository and do not require image generation.
The six production scenes are text-free raster assets intended for composition beneath native HTML/CSS and vector branding.
Do not bake prices, ratings, stock claims, navigation, CTAs, or promotional copy into production scene photography.
Prefer WebP for scene delivery and SVG for logos, icons, controls, and other vector assets.
